qualifier: vitamins A, D and K, including retinoic acid and gamma-carboxylation
name: Vitamin A, D and K metabolism and response
rationale: All members concern retinoid, calciferol or vitamin K metabolism, signaling or vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation, unlike confusables centred on phosphate/bone mineralization, steroid hormone CYPs or the visual retinoid cycle.

qualifier: craniofacial, ear, pharyngeal-derived gland and limb
name: Craniofacial, ear, pharyngeal organ and limb development
rationale: Members are embryonic morphogenesis of head, face, palate, inner/middle/outer ear, pharyngeal glands (thymus, thyroid, parathyroid, pituitary) and limbs/digits, distinguishing them from confusables about salivary/lacrimal glands, cranial nerves or Hox/neural-plate axis patterning.

qualifier: with cilium assembly, disassembly and basal body anchoring
name: Centrosome positioning, centriole duplication and ciliogenesis control
rationale: Members regulate centrosome location, centriole cohesion/duplication/elongation, MTOC microtubule nucleation and primary cilium assembly/disassembly, whereas confusables concern mitotic spindle orientation and mitotic centrosome maturation.

qualifier: potassium channel-mediated (TRESK, Ca2+-activated K+)
name: K+ channel-mediated restraint of neuronal action potentials
rationale: Members regulate resting/presynaptic membrane potential, hyperpolarization and suppression of depolarization and action potentials via K+ channels, unlike confusables on other K2P/KATP channels, pacemaker HCN currents or Na+/K+ ATPase gradients.

qualifier: docking, priming and SNARE-driven release cycle
name: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming and neurotransmitter release cycle
rationale: All members concern vesicle docking, SNARE assembly, priming and calcium-dependent exocytosis of neurotransmitters, unlike confusables on vesicle recycling/endocytosis or GABA/glutamate secretion and short-term plasticity.

qualifier: G1/G2 checkpoint arrest and p53 stabilization (ARF, phosphorylation, degradation)
name: p53 activation and DNA damage cell-cycle checkpoint arrest
rationale: Members cover regulation of TP53 expression, stability and activity, p14ARF defects, p21 induction and G1/G2 DNA damage checkpoints, whereas confusables emphasise p53 apoptotic targets, senescence programmes or AKT signaling.

qualifier: death and dependence-receptor signaling
name: p75 neurotrophin receptor and dependence-receptor death signaling
rationale: Members describe proNGF/NGF binding to p75NTR, its proteolysis, NRAGE/NRIF/NADE/ceramide death signals and ligand-less dependence receptor caspase activation, unlike confusables on TRKA trophic signaling or axon regeneration.

qualifier: neutrophil degranulation
name: Neutrophil degranulation and myeloid inflammatory activation
rationale: Members are inflammatory response, myeloid immunity, monocyte/immune activation modules, complement receptor signaling and neutrophil degranulation, distinguishing it from confusables on respiratory burst, cytotoxic killing or formyl peptide chemotaxis.

qualifier: collagen and elastic fibre assembly and crosslinking
name: Collagen and elastic fibre biosynthesis and crosslinking
rationale: All members concern collagen biosynthesis, fibril organization and crosslinking or elastic fibre assembly, unlike confusables on matrix degradation or basement membrane/integrin interactions.

qualifier: action potential phases and nodal/His-Purkinje conduction
name: Cardiac action potential phases and conduction system
rationale: Members cover the phases of the cardiac action potential, the K+/Na+/HCN channels underlying them, gap junction coupling and SA/AV node and His-Purkinje conduction, unlike confusables on calcium handling and contractile force.

qualifier: telomerase recruitment and telomere chromatin protection (ATRX/DAXX)
name: Telomerase recruitment and telomere chromatin protection
rationale: Members concern telomerase assembly, Cajal body trafficking and telomere extension together with telomere packaging, subtelomeric heterochromatin and ATRX/DAXX inhibition of recombination, unlike confusables on C-strand synthesis, ALT recombination or rRNA modification.

qualifier: ubiquitin-dependent degradation of misfolded proteins and ERAD
name: Ubiquitin-proteasome quality control of misfolded proteins and ERAD
rationale: Members cover E3 ligase ubiquitination, N-end rule and proteasomal catabolism, ERAD regulation, protein unfolding and responses to misfolded proteins, unlike confusables on aggrephagy/chaperone-mediated autophagy or deubiquitinase restraint of degradation.

qualifier: response to UV-A and blue light
name: Melanocyte pigmentation control and UV-A/blue light response
rationale: Members link MITF-dependent pigmentation genes, regulation of pigment (secondary metabolite) synthesis and melanocyte proliferation with UV-A/blue light responses, unlike confusables on melanosome biogenesis or non-pigmentation MITF targets and UV-B.

qualifier: including biosynthesis, secretion and reuptake
name: Serotonin synthesis, reuptake, secretion and receptor signaling
rationale: Every member concerns serotonin biosynthesis, transport, secretion or receptor signaling, distinguishing it from confusables on muscarinic, adenosine or histamine receptors.

qualifier: Ig-superfamily (L1, CHL1, DSCAM, SDK, nectin) in fasciculation and self-avoidance
name: Ig-superfamily neuronal adhesion in fasciculation and self-avoidance
rationale: Members are neuronal adhesion molecule interactions driving fasciculation, dendrite self-avoidance, synapse pruning and contact repulsion, unlike confusables on netrin, semaphorin and SLIT/ROBO axon guidance.

qualifier: with megakaryocyte/platelet branch
name: Erythroid and megakaryocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover erythrocyte and megakaryocyte differentiation, platelet morphogenesis, RUNX1 regulation and erythroid-megakaryocytic modules, unlike confusables on myeloid progenitors/granulopoiesis or erythropoiesis without the megakaryocyte arm.

qualifier: serotonin, muscarinic and adenosine receptors controlling cAMP
name: Serotonin, muscarinic and adenosine receptor cAMP signaling
rationale: Members are serotonin, muscarinic acetylcholine and adenosine receptor signaling with adenylate cyclase inhibition and cAMP breakdown, unlike confusables on nicotinic, histamine, tachykinin or adrenergic receptors.

qualifier: monocarboxylates, TCA dicarboxylates and carnitine
name: Solute carrier transport of metabolic carboxylates and carnitine
rationale: Members concern SLC-mediated transport of lactate/pyruvate, TCA intermediates, organic anions/cations and carnitine and their transporter defects, unlike confusables on carnitine synthesis, creatine, fatty acid or cationic amino acid transport.

qualifier: holoenzyme assembly and Cajal body trafficking
name: Telomerase assembly, Cajal body trafficking and telomere extension
rationale: All members concern telomerase RNA folding, holoenzyme assembly, Cajal body localization and recruitment to extend telomeres, unlike confusables on telomere packaging/protection, snoRNP biology or chaperonin folding.

qualifier: nephric duct, ureteric bud and nephron tubule
name: Nephric duct, ureteric bud and nephron tubule development
rationale: Members cover intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct, ureteric bud and metanephric nephron/tubule morphogenesis and its regulation, unlike confusables on glomerular development or mammary, prostate, lung and salivary branching.

core: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface signature
qualifier: resting state with CD1 lipid antigen presentation
name: Monocyte and resting dendritic cell surface, CD1 lipid presentation
rationale: Members are monocyte and resting DC surface/receptor modules and CD1-mediated lipid antigen presentation, unlike confusables on mature neutrophil/monocyte effector modules, MHC-TLR presentation or activated DC signatures.

qualifier: refolding and inclusion body suppression
name: Chaperone protein folding, refolding and inclusion body suppression
rationale: Members concern de novo, chaperonin and ER folding, refolding, ATP-dependent chaperone activity and limiting inclusion bodies, unlike confusables specific to CCT/TriC substrates, aggrephagy or the heat shock response.

qualifier: defensins and antimicrobial proteins at mucosa
name: Defensins and antimicrobial proteins in mucosal antibacterial defense
rationale: Members cover defensins, antibacterial peptide production, metal sequestration, microbial cytolysis and mucosal antibacterial/antifungal responses, unlike confusables on respiratory burst or antimicrobial peptide regulation and anti-nematode defense.

qualifier: basement membrane, laminin/integrin adhesion and hemidesmosomes
name: Basement membrane, collagen matrix and integrin-laminin adhesion assembly
rationale: Members span collagen and elastic fibre formation, basement membrane and anchoring fibril assembly, laminin/integrin interactions, hemidesmosomes and the dystrophin-glycoprotein complex, unlike confusables on cornified envelope, myogenesis or ECM secretion.

core: Non-Pol II transcription and rRNA processing
qualifier: Pol I/III elongation, termination and pre-rRNA cleavage
name: RNA polymerase I/III elongation, termination and pre-rRNA cleavage
rationale: Members are RNA polymerase I and III elongation and termination plus endonucleolytic pre-rRNA cleavages, unlike confusables on Pol I/III initiation, rRNA gene epigenetic control or tRNA/snRNA transcription.
